coverage_notes.summary: OCHA OPT and WHO were checked first. The bounded supplementary pass then used exactly 12 targeted searches covering Reuters, AP, WAFA, Anadolu, UNICEF, UNRWA, Israeli/COGAT crossing information, ICRC detention/hostage access, ceasefire/mediator developments, Gaza hospital/ambulance/fuel/medical-evacuation capacity, and a final UTC-date rollover check for September 26. No search/source materially failed. No new qualifying development was verified after the prior Gaza Source Watch completion at 19:05:57 PDT. Same-day results were either outside the window, stale, unrelated, or duplicates of already surfaced developments including the Wijdan Camp/Al-Mawasi strike, the Al-Zawaida cemetery strike, Board of Peace-UNRWA contacts, and continuing ICRC denial of detainee access.
